name: Subagents
summary: Hand a side task to a specialised helper that works in its own context and reports back a summary.
what: A subagent is an assistant set up for one kind of task. It has its own context window, its own system prompt and its own list of allowed tools. Claude delegates a matching task to it, the subagent does the work separately, and only its result comes back to your main conversation.

impact.title: A cleaner main conversation
impact.detail: Search results, logs and file contents from a side task stay in the subagent's context instead of filling yours.

impact.title: Tighter limits
impact.detail: Each subagent can be restricted to the tools it needs, for example read-only tools for a reviewer.

impact.title: Reuse
impact.detail: A subagent saved in your home folder is available in all your projects; one saved in a repository is shared with the team.

impact.title: Cost control
impact.detail: A subagent can be set to run on a faster, lower-cost model.

howItWorks: Create a Markdown file in .claude/agents/ (this project) or ~/.claude/agents/ (all your projects).
At the top, add YAML frontmatter with a name and a description, and optionally the tools and model it may use.
Write the subagent's system prompt below the frontmatter.
Claude delegates a task when it matches the description, or you can name the subagent yourself with an @-mention.
The subagent works on its own and returns its result to the main conversation.

events.note: Custom subagents arrived, created with the /agents command.
